trans-unit.source: How come you always wear that hat?
trans-unit.target: How come you always wear that hat?

trans-unit.source: You mean this one? Well, it's...
trans-unit.target: You mean this one? Well, it's...

trans-unit.source: Whose bald head? As if you've ever seen me without my hat!
trans-unit.target: Whose bald head? As if you've ever seen me without my hat!

trans-unit.source: Already forgot the time I peeked on you at the hot spring, Baldie?
trans-unit.target: Already forgot the time I peeked on you at the hot spring, Baldie?

trans-unit.source: Oh dear! I'm sorry I asked about something so sensitive...!
trans-unit.target: Oh dear! I'm sorry I asked about something so sensitive...!

trans-unit.source: N-no! Not at all! She's just confused!
trans-unit.target: N-no! Not at all! She's just confused!
